summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for the Crenessity (crinecerfont) application (jointly filed NDA 218808 / NDA 218820). The Integrated Review states the application did not raise efficacy, safety, or other issues requiring external expert input, and the approval letter similarly notes the applications were not referred to an advisory committee because there were no controversial issues warranting discussion. Accordingly there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
